comments: Registered as one bank on the footing line (the crop bottom); the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones. The painted hall is width-limited: 144 px wide and about 42 px tall on a 60 px canvas.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. The three drawings are stacked, top to bottom: day-0, night-0 (shuttered windows), lit-0 (amber windows, ajar door). The crops are tight and separated by empty rows (checked against the sheet's alpha).
